If there's too many workers, the tail latency might be lower, but if some workers are idle, it could increase.

Request migration is about moving tasks between different workers when their performance drops or resource availability changes. This needs to be managed efficiently to avoid bottlenecks.

Throughput tradeoffs involve balancing the system's ability to handle requests with the efficiency of the workers. If a worker is underutilized, it might not contribute as much to throughput, but if it's overutilized, it might cause performance issues.
